instanceExperimentalSettings.appsDescrip.en: Show the Apps navigation and allow access to app connections, gateways, and advanced app tooling.
instanceExperimentalSettings.appsDescrip.zh-CN: 显示“应用”导航，并允许访问应用连接、网关和高级应用工具。

instanceExperimentalSettings.autoCreateR.en: Automatically create recovery tasks when work needs follow-up.
instanceExperimentalSettings.autoCreateR.zh-CN: 当工作需要跟进时自动创建恢复任务。

instanceExperimentalSettings.autoRecover.zh-CN: 切换任务图存活性自动恢复

instanceExperimentalSettings.autoRecover.en: Let the heartbeat scheduler create recovery tasks for task dependency chains found inside the configured lookback window.
instanceExperimentalSettings.autoRecover.zh-CN: 允许心跳调度器为配置回溯窗口内发现的任务依赖链创建恢复任务。

instanceExperimentalSettings.autoRestart.en: Restart the dev server automatically when local runtime changes require it.
instanceExperimentalSettings.autoRestart.zh-CN: 当本地运行时变更需要重启时，自动重启开发服务器。

instanceExperimentalSettings.betaSkillsD.en: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.
instanceExperimentalSettings.betaSkillsD.zh-CN: 允许智能体固定 Paperclip 核心技能的 beta 版本。禁用后，所有智能体会恢复默认 live 技能，但不会删除已保存的固定版本。

instanceExperimentalSettings.betaSkillsT.zh-CN: 切换 Beta 技能实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.builtInAgen.en: Show Paperclip CN-managed built-in agent surfaces, including roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and setup controls.
instanceExperimentalSettings.builtInAgen.zh-CN: 显示由 Paperclip CN 管理的内置智能体界面，包括名单徽章、“内置智能体”标签页和设置控件。
切换内置智能体实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.casesDescri.en: Durable work products such as blog posts and tweet storms that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
instanceExperimentalSettings.casesDescri.zh-CN: 由任务创建并持续迭代的博客文章、推文串等持久工作成果。启用后会添加“案例”标签页和智能体案例 API。

instanceExperimentalSettings.casesDisabl.en: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.
instanceExperimentalSettings.casesDisabl.zh-CN: 关闭案例功能会隐藏标签页并阻止案例 API，但会保留现有案例数据。

instanceExperimentalSettings.casesToggle.zh-CN: 切换案例实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.classicTask.en: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, and the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
instanceExperimentalSettings.classicTask.zh-CN: 恢复旧版任务详情页，包括页面级标题、描述内联编辑、普通评论讨论串和固定属性侧栏。经典视图不支持流式活动折叠、内联计划和问题卡片以及三模式编辑器等聊天专属功能。

instanceExperimentalSettings.classicTask.en: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
instanceExperimentalSettings.classicTask.zh-CN: 切换会立即生效，不会影响任何任务数据。

instanceExperimentalSettings.classicTask.en: Toggle classic task interface experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.classicTask.zh-CN: 切换经典任务界面实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.cloudSyncDe.en: Sync selected instance data with the cloud when enabled.
instanceExperimentalSettings.cloudSyncDe.zh-CN: 启用后将选定的实例数据同步到云端。

instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceC.en: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceC.zh-CN: 添加“会议室”，让你和整个团队在同一聊天中协作，并提供实时活动流和重新设计的引导流程。任务讨论串也会改为聊天气泡样式；可随时关闭以恢复经典界面。

instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceC.en: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceC.zh-CN: 切换会议室聊天实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceR.en: Enable shared issue chat rooms for coordinated discussion.
instanceExperimentalSettings.conferenceR.zh-CN: 启用用于协同讨论的共享任务聊天室。

instanceExperimentalSettings.confirmAuto.en: Enable automatic recovery task creation now?
instanceExperimentalSettings.confirmAuto.zh-CN: 现在启用自动恢复任务创建吗？

instanceExperimentalSettings.decisionsDe.en: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar, the attention home that surfaces tasks awaiting your input, while the surface is still being evaluated.
instanceExperimentalSettings.decisionsDe.zh-CN: 在主侧栏显示“决策”入口，用于集中呈现等待你输入的任务；此界面仍在评估中。

instanceExperimentalSettings.decisionsTo.zh-CN: 切换决策实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.environment.en: Enable company environment configuration and workspace targets.
instanceExperimentalSettings.environment.zh-CN: 启用公司环境配置和工作区目标。

instanceExperimentalSettings.executionSu.zh-CN: 执行已被抑制，实际等同于关闭。

instanceExperimentalSettings.externalObj.en: Detect external URLs in tasks and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
instanceExperimentalSettings.externalObj.zh-CN: 检测任务中的外部 URL，并显示 Pull Request、工单和其他引用工作对象的解析状态。
切换外部对象实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.fileViewerD.en: Enable browsing and previewing workspace files from task pages.
instanceExperimentalSettings.fileViewerD.zh-CN: 允许在任务页面浏览和预览工作区文件。

instanceExperimentalSettings.goalsSideba.en: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
instanceExperimentalSettings.goalsSideba.zh-CN: 在目标界面仍处于评估期间，将“目标”入口恢复到主侧栏。

instanceExperimentalSettings.goalsSideba.en: Toggle goals sidebar link experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.goalsSideba.zh-CN: 切换目标侧栏入口实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.isolatedWor.en: Run agent work in isolated workspaces when configured.
instanceExperimentalSettings.isolatedWor.zh-CN: 在配置后让智能体工作运行于隔离工作区中。

instanceExperimentalSettings.issuePlanDe.en: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on issue detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
instanceExperimentalSettings.issuePlanDe.zh-CN: 在任务详情页显示已接受计划的拆解历史。用于在展示方式仍在优化时调试和验证子任务创建行为。

instanceExperimentalSettings.issuePlanDe.en: Toggle issue plan decomposition panel experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.issuePlanDe.zh-CN: 切换任务计划拆解面板实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.lookbackHou.en: Enter a lookback window between 1 and 720 hours.
instanceExperimentalSettings.lookbackHou.zh-CN: 请输入 1 到 720 小时之间的回溯窗口。

instanceExperimentalSettings.managedSand.en: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed sandbox environment.
instanceExperimentalSettings.managedSand.zh-CN: 隐藏本地环境，并让所有智能体都在平台托管的沙箱环境中运行。

instanceExperimentalSettings.managedSand.en: Toggle managed sandbox only experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.managedSand.zh-CN: 切换仅使用托管沙箱实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.noRecoveryT.en: No recovery tasks need to be created right now.
instanceExperimentalSettings.noRecoveryT.zh-CN: 当前不需要创建恢复任务。

instanceExperimentalSettings.outsideLook.en: outside the configured lookback and will not be touched.
instanceExperimentalSettings.outsideLook.zh-CN: 项位于配置的回溯范围之外，不会被处理。

instanceExperimentalSettings.planDecompo.en: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
instanceExperimentalSettings.planDecompo.zh-CN: 在任务详情页显示已接受计划的分解历史，用于调试和验证子任务创建行为；界面仍在完善中。

instanceExperimentalSettings.planDecompo.en: Toggle task plan decomposition panel experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.planDecompo.zh-CN: 切换任务计划分解面板实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.previewExec.en: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
instanceExperimentalSettings.previewExec.zh-CN: 这是隔离的 git worktree 预览实例。启用后，调度器可在此执行运行。只有启用后创建的任务会自动运行；复制或已存在的任务仍保持停放。关闭再开启会重置截止时间。

instanceExperimentalSettings.recoveryPre.zh-CN: 发现 {{count}} 个恢复候选项。

instanceExperimentalSettings.recoverySta.en: Blocked by an assigned backlog task
instanceExperimentalSettings.recoverySta.zh-CN: 被已分配的待办任务阻塞
被不可用的负责人阻塞

instanceExperimentalSettings.recoverySta.en: In review without an action path
instanceExperimentalSettings.recoverySta.zh-CN: 审核中但没有后续操作路径

instanceExperimentalSettings.runningAfte.zh-CN: 运行创建于此时间之后的任务

instanceExperimentalSettings.serverInfoD.en: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
instanceExperimentalSettings.serverInfoD.zh-CN: 在账户抽屉中显示“服务器”区域，包含当前服务器重启时间和正在运行的提交。

instanceExperimentalSettings.serverInfoD.en: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.serverInfoD.zh-CN: 切换服务器信息调试视图实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.simplifiedE.en: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, and checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
instanceExperimentalSettings.simplifiedE.zh-CN: 要求智能体使用 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语编写用户交互（计划确认、问题、建议任务和复选框提示），并简要说明决策需要哪些信息以及各选项会产生什么结果。

instanceExperimentalSettings.simplifiedE.en: Toggle simplified English interactions experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.simplifiedE.zh-CN: 切换简化英语交互实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.skippedOuts.zh-CN: 因超出回溯窗口而跳过

instanceExperimentalSettings.smokeLabDes.en: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.
instanceExperimentalSettings.smokeLabDes.zh-CN: 在“应用 → 开发者”下添加“冒烟实验室”标签页，并在仪表盘上添加“集成冒烟测试”卡片，用于通过确定性的本地夹具（模拟 OAuth 提供方 + 回环 MCP 服务器）验证所有集成路径。仅限非公开部署。

instanceExperimentalSettings.smokeLabTog.zh-CN: 切换“冒烟实验室”实验功能

instanceExperimentalSettings.statusCards.en: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimentalSettings.statusCards.zh-CN: 启用实验性的共享状态卡片看板及其受控 API。禁用后仍会保留现有卡片数据。

instanceExperimentalSettings.statusCards.en: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.
instanceExperimentalSettings.statusCards.zh-CN: 启用状态卡片时也会启用摘要。
切换状态卡片实验功能设置

instanceExperimentalSettings.streamlined.en: Reduces the maximum number of items in the left navigation bar — nests Projects under Work with a dedicated Projects page, and shows only active agents (max 5 recently-active) in the sidebar.
Toggle streamlined left navigation experimental setting

instanceExperimentalSettings.subtitle.en: Try guarded features before they become default.
instanceExperimentalSettings.subtitle.zh-CN: 在功能默认启用前先试用受控功能。

instanceExperimentalSettings.summariesDe.en: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimentalSettings.summariesDe.zh-CN: 在项目和工作区页面显示由摘要智能体生成的状态摘要，支持按需刷新和修订历史。关闭后仍会保留现有摘要数据。

instanceExperimentalSettings.summariesFo.en: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.
instanceExperimentalSettings.summariesFo.zh-CN: 状态卡片依赖摘要。禁用摘要时也会禁用状态卡片。

instanceExperimentalSettings.taskWatchdo.en: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.
instanceExperimentalSettings.taskWatchdo.zh-CN: 启用任务看护，用于跟进和健康检查。

instanceExperimentalSettings.warningBody.en: These features are opt-in and come with no compatibility guarantees. They may change, break, or be removed without notice. Avoid relying on them for critical or production workflows.
instanceExperimentalSettings.warningBody.zh-CN: 实验功能在开发期间可能变更或重置。

instanceExperimentalSettings.warningTitl.en: Experimental features may break at any time.

instanceExperimentalSettings.workspacesD.en: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.
instanceExperimentalSettings.workspacesD.zh-CN: 在项目配置中显示执行工作区控件，并允许新旧任务运行使用隔离工作区。

instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.zh-CN: 将运行在 {{timestamp}} 之后创建的任务。

instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.en: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically; copied or pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.zh-CN: 这是一个隔离的 Git worktree 预览实例。启用后，调度器可以在此执行运行。只有启用后创建的任务会自动运行；复制或预先存在的任务仍保持停放。关闭后重新启用会重置生效时间。

instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.en: This setting was armed in a different instance and copied here, so no tasks run automatically.
instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.zh-CN: 此设置在另一个实例中启用后被复制到这里，因此任务不会自动运行。

instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.en: This setting is missing its activation cutoff, so no tasks run automatically.
instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.zh-CN: 此设置缺少生效时间，因此任务不会自动运行。

instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.en: This preview instance has no stable instance ID, so no tasks run automatically.
instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.zh-CN: 此预览实例没有稳定的实例 ID，因此任务不会自动运行。

instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.en: Toggle it off and back on to arm execution for tasks created here.
instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.zh-CN: 请关闭后重新启用，为在此创建的任务激活自动执行。

instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.en: Execution is suppressed; this setting is effectively off.
instanceExperimentalSettings.worktreeRun.zh-CN: 执行已被抑制；此设置实际处于关闭状态。
在此 worktree 中运行任务
切换 worktree 运行执行设置
